notes: Design not named; retrospective cohort inferred from existing EHR records followed 28–180 days. Period trends in visit rates (Table 3) are side by side with no test. Follow-up truncation at 180 days is a design step, not a procedure.
view_issues: Wilcoxon signed-rank (a paired test) is named for comparing independent groups. Table 1 gives race p<0.001 while text gives p = 0.04 for Black vs all others. Table 1 obesity row 391 (12.3) is inconsistent with 391/1,452 (~26.9%).
